en.title: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade Hits New Low Price on Switch 2
en.summary: The critically acclaimed **Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade** is now available at an unprecedented price point for Nintendo Switch 2 owners. This massive discount offers a perfect gateway for newcomers and returning fans to experience Cloud Strife's journey.
en.body:
The epic saga of **Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade** continues to draw players into its reimagined world, and now, it's more affordable than ever on the **Nintendo Switch 2**. A recent sale has seen the game plummet to an all-time low price, presenting an unmissable opportunity for fans to dive into the Midgar portion of Cloud Strife's unforgettable adventure.

This isn't just a simple port; **Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade** brings the full Midgar story to Nintendo's latest console, complete with the **INTERmission** episode starring the fan-favorite ninja, Yuffie Kisaragi. Critics have lauded the Switch 2 version, with IGN's Logan Plant describing it as an "impressive port for both newcomers and those returning to Midgar," noting that it "checks pretty much every box you could ask for from a portable version." It's a testament to the developers' skill in bringing such a visually stunning and complex RPG to a handheld format.

## A Stellar Deal for a Stellar Game

While Amazon's Prime Day sale may be a memory, savvy shoppers can still snag **Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade** for a mere $25. This marks a new all-time low for the game, and crucially, you don't even need an Amazon Prime membership to take advantage of this fantastic offer. For those keeping an eye on the digital storefronts, the **Nintendo Switch US eShop** is also offering the game at an incredible $9.99, a price that will remain valid until October 1, 2026. This dual availability ensures that players have multiple avenues to grab this definitive version of the Midgar story. It's important to note that the physical edition utilizes a Game-Key Card, meaning a download is required, a detail that might be a consideration for collectors who prefer physical media.

## The Road to **Final Fantasy VII Rebirth** and Beyond

This incredible pricing comes at a pivotal moment for the **Final Fantasy VII** franchise. With **Final Fantasy VII Rebirth** already available on the **Nintendo Switch 2**, and the highly anticipated conclusion, **Final Fantasy VII Revelation**, slated for release on January 22, 2026, now is the *perfect* time to catch up. **Revelation** promises to bring Cloud's story to a dramatic close, featuring epic clashes with the gargantuan Weapons and the ultimate confrontation with Sephiroth himself. The Switch 2 launch of **Revelation** will reportedly coincide with all other platforms, a welcome change for players who have historically faced staggered releases. This current deal on **Intergrade** ensures that everyone can be ready for the grand finale, experiencing the foundational Midgar story before the final chapter unfolds.

content_raw: Amazon's Prime Day sale may be over, but there are still some decent video game deals to be found if you know where to look. One of the best we've spotted is on Final Fantasy 7 Remake Intergrade for Nintendo Switch 2 , which has dropped to just $25 at Amazon. That's a new all-time low for the RPG, and the best part is that you don't even need an Amazon Prime membership to take advantage of it anymore. Save on Final Fantasy 7 Remake Intergrade for Nintendo Switch 2 Final Fantasy 7 Remake Intergrade includes the full remake of the original RPG's Midgar story, along with INTERmission, an additional episode starring Yuffie. Just bear in mind that this physical edition uses a Game-Key Card, so you'll need to download the game rather than play it directly from the card. I know some people are very much against the idea of owning these, so I thought best to mention it. We gave the Switch 2 version an impressive review, with IGN's Logan Plant describing it as an "impressive port for both newcomers and those returning to Midgar." In our review update , Logan also noted that the game "checks pretty much every box you could ask for from a portable version." If you've been waiting for a chance to play this one on Nintendo's latest console, $25 is a particularly good excuse to finally jump in. We also consider Final Fantasy 7 Remake one of the best video game remakes of all time . Its gorgeous reimagining of Midgar, memorable cast of characters, and revamped real-time combat make it a standout RPG, whether you're returning to the story or experiencing it for the first time. It's the perfect time to jump in, as well, with Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth also now on Switch 2 , and the final game in the trilogy, Final Fantasy 7 Revelation , set to release on the console, alongside PS5, Xbox, and PC, on April 7, 2026. If you're keen to see where the trilogy is heading, IGN has already gone hands-on with Revelation, sharing our impressions in two recent previews here . In the meantime, Final Fantasy 7 Remake is an excellent place to start, or revisit, before the trilogy reaches its conclusion.
